answer: The protocol assigns each agent a “trust weight” computed by max‑flow from a globally known anchor node (the lantern) across the tundra‑wide graph of verified interactions; a falcon‑speed edge represents the strongest historic link and caps the flow that can pass through any downstream node. When a new identity appears it must purchase capacity on a bottleneck edge by staking collateral equal to the desired flow, and the flow limit is enforced on every downstream hop, so a Sybil cluster can only draw reward up to the smallest stake among its links.
